_comment: RQ1 settings shared by every dataset config in this folder. Each setting names the file it reads in the course's run_dir and the file <name>.stats.json ({"llm_calls": n}) that gives its LLM calls. adds_calls_of: validator settings also pay for discovery. 'produce' says how the predictions file is made; The four ablations are real flags of cdlp/validation/__main__.py (--skip-evidence / --skip-semantic / --skip-necessity / --skip-graph); each writes <run_dir>/<name>.stats.json itself. Cost per edge = (llm_calls + cache_hits) / edges; real calls are reported separately (evaluate.py).

settings.name: discovery_only
settings.description: Candidate filter + per-pair LLM discovery, no validation.

settings.name: baseline_prompt
settings.description: One 'list all prerequisites' call with the full concept list, no filter.

settings.name: single_judge
settings.description: The semantic check alone (prompt semantic_v2), one validator call per proposed edge at temperature 0, seed 42: ACCEPT if strong or medium, else REJECT. No retrieval, no other check.

settings.name: self_consistency
settings.description: The single judge sampled 3 times (seeds 42, 43, 44, temperature 0.7), majority vote; confidence = vote share. Spends several calls per edge like the agent but adds no independent evidence, so it separates 'more calls' from 'independent checks'.

settings.name: full_agent
settings.description: Validation agent: evidence, semantic (semantic_v2) and graph checks decide; the necessity test runs and is recorded on every edge but is report-only (weight 0), because it was unstable across runs.

settings.name: full_agent_plus_necessity
settings.description: Full agent with the necessity test deciding at its normal weight (1, like evidence and semantic). Run after full_agent: the necessity calls come from the cache.

settings.name: minus_evidence
settings.description: Full agent without the evidence check.

settings.name: minus_semantic
settings.description: Full agent without the semantic check.

settings.name: minus_necessity
settings.description: Full agent without running the necessity test. Since necessity is report-only, the decisions equal full_agent's; this setting measures the calls the test costs. Its effect on decisions is full_agent_plus_necessity vs full_agent.

settings.name: minus_evidence_necessity
settings.description: Agent with the semantic and graph checks only (evidence and necessity off). The reported agent on benchmarks, which have no course text for either check.

settings.name: minus_graph
settings.description: Full agent without the graph-consistency check (no LLM calls saved; tests cycles / redundancy).
